{"items":[{"item_id":"h051","prompts":["产线上的测试工程师每天填的不良原因五花八门，我想把下面这批原始记录整理成规范的编码。产品码本：A01=屏幕划伤，A02=屏幕碎裂，B03=扬声器无声，C05=电池鼓包，D07=按键失灵。原始记录如下：
1. "屏mo划伤，有点明显"
2. "喇叭木有声音"
3. "battery鼓包了"
4. "屏幕碎了 corner"
5. "按键按下没反应"
请帮我逐条归一化，纠正拼写、中英混杂和模糊表述，并给出对应的编码和置信度。"],"rubric":["Each of the 5 raw records is mapped to a codebook code (A01, B03, C05, A02, D07 respectively)","Typos, mixed Chinese-English and ambiguous wording are corrected with explanations","A confidence level is provided for each mapping","Station/context validation or notes on ambiguous entries are included"]},{"item_id":"h052","prompts":["我在做一个小车的自适应巡航demo，需要实现跟车控制：当前车速从110 km/h要收敛到目标100 km/h，油门和刹车由同一个控制器输出。请帮我写一个带比例、积分、微分三项的反馈控制回路Python实现，包含抗积分饱和，并用一段模拟数据演示速度收敛过程。"],"rubric":["A working PID control loop implementation in code is provided","Throttle/brake output handling and anti-windup are implemented","A simulation demonstrates speed converging from 110 to 100 km/h","Gains are tunable parameters with reasonable defaults"]},{"item_id":"h053","prompts":["我想给syzkaller写一个fuzzer描述，目标是Linux的/dev/mydev设备，ioctl命令号 0x40081234，参数是一个指向 8 字节结构体的指针（包含一个 u32 类型的 len 字段和一个 u32 类型的 pad 字段）。请帮我用 syzlang 语法写出对应的 syscall 描述。"],"rubric":["Correct syzlang resource/type declarations for the ioctl struct (u32 len, u32 pad)","The ioctl command number 0x40081234 is properly described","Syntax is valid syzlang (define, type, syscall declaration)","Brief explanation of each syzlang construct is given"]},{"item_id":"h054","prompts":["我在维护一个开源项目的discussion，有人在一个关于构建失败的问题帖下面回复了我的追问，提供了关键的报错日志。请帮我在那个回复下面追加一条评论，内容是："谢谢！这个日志很关键，问题已经定位，我会在下个版本修复。"并且把我这条新评论标记为该讨论的答案。"],"rubric":["The workflow correctly describes adding a reply comment to the existing comment","Comment content matches the user's intended message","Marking the new comment as the answer is included","No unrelated GitHub operations are performed"]},{"item_id":"h055","prompts":["帮我查一下 pydantic/pydantic 这个 GitHub 仓库目前都有哪些 tag，我想确认最新发布的版本号。"],"rubric":["The tool used lists tags from the pydantic/pydantic repository","The response includes a list of tag names","The latest version is identified or the tags are ordered so the newest is determinable"]},{"item_id":"h056","prompts":["我有一个抓包文件，想分析里面的TCP连接情况：总共建立了多少条连接、每条连接的握手时长、以及有没有重传。请告诉我用什么Python方法可以解析pcap文件并统计这些网络指标。"],"rubric":["A Python-based approach (e.g., scapy/dpkt) for parsing PCAP files is described","TCP connection count via handshake matching is computed","Handshake latency and retransmission statistics are included","Runnable code or tested utility functions are provided"]},{"item_id":"h057","prompts":["我想搭一个四旋翼无人机的仿真，给定期望的总推力和三个力矩，通过螺旋桨分配矩阵算出四个电机的转速，电机响应用一阶惯性环节模拟，然后用RK45积分平动和转动的非线性动力学方程。请帮我实现这个仿真，并给出悬停状态下10秒的仿真结果。"],"rubric":["A propeller allocation matrix maps thrust/moments to individual motor RPMs","First-order motor lag is modeled","RK45 integration of translational and rotational equations of motion is implemented","A 10-second hover simulation result is produced and briefly analyzed"]},{"item_id":"h058","prompts":["我有一份销售数据，想搞清楚到底哪些因素在驱动销量。数据（每月一条）：广告费(万元)、促销力度(1-5)、价格(元)、销量(千件)：
(20, 3, 99, 8.5), (35, 4, 99, 12.1), (20, 4, 89, 11.8), (35, 3, 89, 10.2), (10, 2, 109, 6.1), (50, 5, 89, 13.9), (10, 5, 99, 9.4), (35, 2, 109, 7.3)
请用方差分解的办法量化广告费、促销和价格各自对销量差异的贡献占比。"],"rubric":["R² decomposition (variance decomposition) method is correctly applied","Contribution percentages of ad spend, promotion and price are computed","Calculations use the provided 8 data points","Results are presented with brief interpretation"]},{"item_id":"h059","prompts":["我想在我的服务器上批量生成一批宣传用的配图：10张赛博朋克风格的城市夜景，然后挑一张最好的生成5秒的宣传短视频。请告诉我怎么通过命令行调用这些AI模型来完成图片和视频生成。"],"rubric":["The approach uses a CLI (inference.sh) to run image and video generation models","Commands for generating 10 cyberpunk city images are provided","A 5-second video generation command/workflow is included","No interactive manual tooling is required; commands are runnable"]},{"item_id":"h060","prompts":["帮我看一下 tensorflow/tensorflow 仓库里现在有哪些open的 pull request，列个清单。"],"rubric":["The tool used lists pull requests from the tensorflow/tensorflow repository","The response contains a list of open PRs with titles/numbers or a summary count","No search-based tool is used since no author filter was specified"]}]}
